title: QCLI-325 round 2: add the fourth reworded prose site to the drift guard, and correct the CHANGELOG entry (four sites, plus the status-flow fields extension)
description:
Two minor findings from QCLI-325's review round 2 (opum-control review seq 8416, head ee874ae3cbeb4ee1e7eaa4485bb4524486e71ff2). MUST LAND BEFORE THE NEXT lore+quest PAIR RELEASE, because the CHANGELOG entry ships with that release and would otherwise record the wrong scope.

(1) THE DRIFT GUARD MISSES THE FOURTH SITE. test/qcli325-paused-status-fixed.test.ts pins three prose sites (the task status-flow help, the task pause help, the task-finalization guide) against the promise phrasing. QCLI-325's round-1 fix reworded a FOURTH site -- the task start help (src/application/command-help.ts) -- but did not add it to the guard's sites list, so its wording can drift back silently. (The OLD task start phrasing, "does not configure that literal itself", also matches none of the guard's three alternations, so it would need a broader regex or a per-site phrase list.)

(2) THE CHANGELOG UNDERCOUNTS. CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased entry says "the three prose sites that read as a promise of a workspace knob now state the real behaviour", but that same commit reworded FOUR; and the entry calls the change "a docs and wire-field change only" without saying that task status-flow's advertised manifest `fields` gained pausedStatusConfigurable. The durable release record is what a consumer reads to answer "did anything I depend on change?", so both need correcting: four sites, and name the fields extension.

Do NOT amend PR #567 for either -- that would change the approved revision. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: test/qcli325-paused-status-fixed.test.ts's drift guard covers all four reworded prose sites, including the task start help, and the guard's phrases go red against each site's pre-QCLI-325 wording
CHANGELOG.md's entry names four prose sites (not three) and states that task status-flow's manifest `fields` gained `pausedStatusConfigurable`

finalSummary:
Two minor findings from QCLI-325's review round 2. Both fixed in files outside PR #567, which is left alone.

AC1: test/qcli325-paused-status-fixed.test.ts's drift guard now covers all FOUR reworded prose sites, and does so with PER-SITE phrases rather than the shared triple. The fourth -- the task start help -- is why that was needed: its pre-QCLI-325 wording ("when the workspace does not configure that literal itself") matched NONE of the guard's three promise alternations, and its current wording ("the paused literal is BUILT IN and the workspace cannot configure it") does not carry the "not workspace-configurable" phrase the other three share, so adding it to the old list would have asserted a phrase it does not contain.

Proved BOTH WAYS and MEASURED, with the counts asserted on every run. Each site carries its real pre-QCLI-325 sentence and the guard is a PREDICATE, run against both: 4/4 sites GREEN on their current wording and 4/4 RED on the wording each replaced. A the test also asserts the table has four sites, so dropping one moves the counts rather than passing quietly. Verified a second way by mutation: reverting the fourth site to its old phrase turns the test red and names "task start" -- which the guard could not have done before this change, because that site was not in its list at all.

AC2: CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased entry corrected. It now states FOUR prose sites (it said three) and names the manifest surface the same commit moved: `task status-flow`'s `data` gains `pausedStatusConfigurable` AND the command's manifest `fields` declares it. The field name was read from the producing source -- the status-flow entry's `fields` in src/contract/tracker/index.ts, emitted at src/cli/commands/task/index.ts -- not from the instruction that named it. The old "a docs and wire-field change only" wording understated the manifest change, and a release record is what a consumer reads to answer "did anything I depend on change?".

Verified: bun run check exits 0 (1163 CLI tests, the mod suite 45 pass / 0 fail) and tsc --noEmit is clean. Lands before the next lore+quest pair release, since the CHANGELOG entry ships with it.
